title: TERMon: Detecting Persistent Behavioral Threats in Edge AI via Hardware-Native Ternary Runtime Monitor
abstract: arXiv:2609.21713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Edge AI accelerators are increasingly deployed in safety-critical environments, where model outputs may control physical actuators, make access-control decisions, or trigger alarms. In these settings, runtime failures often remain undetected because model corruption, distribution shift, and adversarial inputs can still produce well-formed, confident predictions. This paper presents TERMon, a lightweight hardware runtime monitor that detects such anomalies by observing inference behavior rather than re-executing or formally verifying the model. TERMon represents class-conditional trusted behavior as hardware-efficient ternary patterns that are matched in parallel against a thermometer-encoded fingerprint. The ternary encoding reproduces the corresponding unquantized range decision exactly. TERMon detects harmful weight corruptions in proportion to their behavioral impact, while out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs are largely not

translated_title: TERMon：通过硬件原生三值运行时监视器检测边缘人工智能中的持续行为威胁
translated_abstract: 边缘AI加速器越来越多地被部署在安全关键环境中，在这些环境中，模型输出可能控制物理执行器、做出访问控制决策或触发警报。在这些场景下，运行时故障往往难以被检测到，因为模型损坏、分布偏移和对抗性输入仍然可以产生格式良好且置信度高的预测。本文提出了TERMon，这是一种轻量级的硬件运行时监视器，它通过观察推理行为而非重新执行或形式化验证模型来检测此类异常。TERMon将类条件可信行为表示为硬件高效的三值模式，并将其与温度计编码的指纹进行并行匹配。该三值编码能够精确再现相应的未量化范围决策。TERMon能够按行为影响的比例检测有害的权重损坏，而分布外输入和对抗性输入在很大程度上不会……
tldr: TERMon是一种轻量级硬件运行时监视器，通过硬件高效的三值模式匹配来观察推理行为，能够有效检测边缘AI中传统方法难以发现的模型损坏、分布偏移和对抗性输入等持续行为威胁。
en_tdlr: TERMon is a lightweight hardware-native runtime monitor that detects persistent behavioral threats in Edge AI—such as weight corruption, distribution shift, and adversarial inputs—by observing inference behavior through hardware-efficient ternary pattern matching rather than re-executing or formally verifying the model.
